# CXNM - Standard - WIN - U - Compliance BitLocker

Checks whether the system drive is encrypted with BitLocker. Twelve hours' grace, because encryption takes a while after enrolment.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | User (U) — assign to user groups |
| Type | Compliance |
| Assignment | All Users |
| Source | OpenIntuneBaseline Windows v4.0 — CP - Device Health - U - BitLocker |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_U_Compliance_BitLocker.json`](Baseline_WIN_U_Compliance_BitLocker.json) |

> Since OIB v4.0 one check per policy instead of four bundled policies, so that grace periods and exceptions can be handled per check. Together with the eight other WIN - U - Compliance policies from v4.0, the replacement for Compliance Device Health, Device Security and Defender for Endpoint; Compliance Password has been dropped (see _renames.json).

## Standards

| Framework | Controls |
|---|---|

| NIS2 art. 21(2) | art. 21(2)(f) assessing the effectiveness<br>art. 21(2)(h) cryptography and encryption |
| CIS Controls v8.1 | 3.6 Encrypt Data on End-User Devices |
| NIST CSF 2.0 | DE.CM-09<br>PR.DS-01 |

What this means per standard and what is needed organisationally alongside it: [COMPLIANCE.en.md](../../../docs/COMPLIANCE.en.md).
